title: Document Eglot customization options
description: README currently shows basic Eglot setup but does not document pkl-ts-mode-eglot-pkl-path, Java path/args, server version, install directory, or how pkl-lsp is downloaded. Add concise documentation for these customization points and common troubleshooting cases.
acceptance_criteria: README explains pkl-ts-mode-eglot-init, automatic pkl-lsp download, Java requirements, pkl CLI path configuration, server version/install directory customization, and a minimal troubleshooting note for Eglot events/configuration issues.
notes: Documentation-only change to README: new 'Language server (Eglot)' section with a customization table (server-version, install-dir, java-path, java-args, pkl-path), the auto-download behavior, pkl-ts-mode-eglot-init / pkl-ts-mode-eglot-install-server, Java 22+ requirement, and a troubleshooting list (pkl not found / exec-path vs PATH per pmo-45j, Java, eglot-events-buffer, re-download). Also fixed an orphaned paragraph-object note that a prior edit had stranded at the end of the README.
close_reason: Documented Eglot integration in the README: new Language server (Eglot) section covering pkl-ts-mode-eglot-init, automatic pkl-lsp JAR download, Java 22+ requirement, a customization table for all five defcustoms (server-version, install-dir, java-path, java-args, pkl-path), pkl-ts-mode-eglot-install-server, and a troubleshooting list (pkl not found via exec-path vs PATH, Java, eglot-events-buffer, re-download). Also fixed an orphaned paragraph-object note in the README.

title: Add CI for tests and byte compilation
description: Add a CI workflow that runs the ERT test suite and byte-compiles the package. The workflow should clarify whether Evil is installed for optional integration compilation or whether only core files are byte-compiled without Evil.
design: GitHub Actions workflow, matrix over Emacs 29.4 and 30.1 (29+ is the documented floor). Each job: install Pkl tree-sitter grammar non-interactively, byte-compile core files (warnings as errors), run 'make test' (Evil stub path), install Evil from NonGNU ELPA, byte-compile the Evil integration (warnings as errors), run the suite again under real Evil. Covers both the with-Evil and without-Evil paths explicitly. Required fixing pre-existing _beg/_end/_type underscore args in the original text objects: evil-define-text-object's expansion uses them, so the underscore triggered 'not left unused' warnings under real-Evil compilation.
acceptance_criteria: CI runs on pushes/PRs; make test passes in CI; byte compilation is checked for supported files; the Evil optional integration path is explicitly covered or documented.
close_reason: Added .github/workflows/ci.yml: matrix over Emacs 29.4/30.1, installs Pkl grammar, byte-compiles core + Evil integration with warnings-as-errors, runs the suite on both the stub and real-Evil paths. Fixed pre-existing _beg/_end/_type underscore args that warned under real-Evil compilation. Documented build/test in README and CLAUDE.md.

title: Add Imenu support for Pkl symbols
description: Add imenu integration so users can navigate Pkl classes, type aliases, methods, and properties from imenu/consult-imenu/etc. A tree-sitter based imenu-create-index-function would fit the existing implementation.
acceptance_criteria: pkl-ts-mode buffers expose useful imenu entries for top-level symbols and relevant nested class/object members; entries navigate to the correct buffer positions; tests cover representative symbols.
notes: Implement via treesit-simple-imenu-settings (Emacs 29 tree-sitter imenu bridge; treesit-major-mode-setup already wires imenu-create-index-function). Categorized: Class (clazz), Type (typeAlias), Method (class/objectMethod), Property (class/objectProperty). Custom NAME-FN extracts the defining identifier (direct identifier child; for methods, identifier under methodHeader) to avoid grabbing annotation/param identifiers.
close_reason: Added categorized Imenu via treesit-simple-imenu-settings: Class (clazz), Type (typeAlias), Method (class/objectMethod), Property (class/objectProperty). NAME-FN helpers extract the defining identifier (under methodHeader for methods, first direct identifier child otherwise). Top-level symbols, class members, and nested object members all indexed; nesting uses treesit's standard (" " . marker) self-entry convention. Tests cover category names (incl. nested host) and entry positions. README feature bullet added.

title: Improve optional Evil integration packaging
description: pkl-ts-mode-evil.el hard-requires evil, so byte-compiling every source file fails when Evil is not installed. Decide how optional Evil support should be packaged and compiled: document/build-skip the optional file, add package metadata that makes Evil available for that file, or guard the optional feature more explicitly.
design: Resolution: the core package (pkl-ts-mode.el, pkl-ts-mode-eglot.el) already byte-compiles WITHOUT Evil because all Evil references are guarded (with-eval-after-load / boundp). The optional pkl-ts-mode-evil.el genuinely needs Evil's macros (evil-define-text-object/-key) to compile, so it cannot be compiled without Evil. Make the two build paths explicit and documented instead of forcing a single compile-everything path. (1) Add Makefile targets: 'compile' (core, no Evil, warnings-as-errors), 'compile-evil' (needs Evil on load path), 'test' (stub path), 'test-evil' (real Evil), 'clean'. A PACKAGE_INIT make var lets CI/local point at an Evil install. (2) Point CI at the make targets (DRY with pmo-7bt). (3) Document in the Evil file commentary that Evil is a hard dep of that file but optional for the package, loaded lazily via with-eval-after-load. Tests keep working without Evil via the existing stub.
acceptance_criteria: Core package byte-compilation has a clear supported path without requiring Evil, or Evil is declared as an explicit compile/runtime dependency for the optional file; tests still support environments without Evil via the existing stub.
close_reason: Made the optional Evil packaging explicit: Makefile targets compile (core, no Evil) / compile-evil / test / test-evil / clean with a PACKAGE_INIT knob; CI now calls the make targets; pkl-ts-mode-evil.el commentary documents the hard-for-this-file/optional-for-package split and lazy with-eval-after-load loading; README and CLAUDE.md updated.

title: Register Pkl file extensions unconditionally
description: pkl-ts-mode currently adds .pkl and .pcf entries to auto-mode-alist only when treesit-ready-p reports the grammar is installed at load time. This means installing the grammar later does not make file associations work until the package is reloaded or the user manually configures :mode. Register extensions unconditionally and let pkl-ts-mode report the missing grammar when entered.
acceptance_criteria: Opening .pkl/.pcf selects pkl-ts-mode even before the grammar is installed; entering the mode still gives the existing clear missing-grammar error; README guidance remains accurate.
notes: Register .pkl, .pcf, and exact-name PklProject in auto-mode-alist unconditionally (was gated behind treesit-ready-p at load time) with a ;;;###autoload cookie so associations work before the grammar is installed and the package autoloads on demand. Missing-grammar user-error on mode entry unchanged. Added auto-mode-alist test and README note. User-requested addition: extensionless PklProject project files.
close_reason: Register .pkl, .pcf, and exact-name PklProject in auto-mode-alist unconditionally via a ;;;###autoload cookie (was gated behind treesit-ready-p at load time). Associations now work before the grammar is installed and the package autoloads on demand; missing-grammar user-error on entry unchanged. README quickstart switched from redundant :mode to :defer t. Added auto-mode-alist test.

title: Add standard Emacs package headers
description: The package headers are minimal. Add typical package metadata such as Package-Requires, Version, URL, Keywords, Author/Maintainer as appropriate so package-vc, MELPA-style checks, and byte-compile tooling can understand the package normally.
acceptance_criteria: Public .el files have appropriate package headers; dependency declarations cover Emacs/treesit/Eglot and optional Evil decisions; package-lint/checkdoc-style metadata warnings are reduced.
notes: Latest release tag is v0.4.0 (13 tags total). Stamp Version: 0.4.0 on the main file (maintainer bumps at next tag). Package-Requires: ((emacs "29.1")) on main only — treesit and eglot are built-in to 29+, Evil stays optional/undeclared per pmo-c9z. Add Author/Maintainer/URL/Keywords to all three public files; Version/Package-Requires only on the main pkl-ts-mode.el.
close_reason: Added standard Emacs Library Headers to all three public files. Main file (pkl-ts-mode.el): Author, Maintainer, Version 0.4.0 (latest tag), Package-Requires ((emacs "29.1")), Keywords, URL, SPDX GPL-3.0-or-later. Secondary files (eglot, evil): Author, Maintainer, Keywords, URL, SPDX (no Version/Package-Requires per multi-file convention). Evil intentionally not declared as a dependency (optional, per pmo-c9z). Verified package-buffer-info parses name/version/requires/url/keywords; byte-compile clean; no header-related checkdoc warnings.

title: Simplify Pkl workspace configuration delegation
description: Simplify the pkl-lsp workspace/configuration handler by delegating non-Pkl items one at a time instead of partitioning and merging by index.
close_reason: Simplified workspace/configuration delegation to handle each item in order, calling Eglot's base handler once per non-Pkl item.

title: Partition Pkl workspace configuration handling
description: Refine the custom pkl-lsp workspace/configuration handler so Pkl-scoped items are handled locally while non-Pkl scopes are delegated to Eglot and merged back in original order.
close_reason: Partitioned workspace/configuration items by scope, handled Pkl entries locally, delegated other scopes to Eglot, and merged results in original order.

title: bug: emacs not detecting the plk executable even when it is present in path.
close_reason: Confirmed the Pkl workspace/configuration fix works and removed the obsolete PATH/env wrapper used by the earlier workaround.

title: Add Makefile test target
description: Provide a simple default Makefile target that runs the full Emacs ERT test suite.
close_reason: Added default Makefile test target and verified it with make.

title: Improve Evil text objects for classes and comments
description: Use t for class/type text objects, repurpose c for comment text objects, and preserve intuitive inner/outer comment ranges.
notes: Final mapping decision: comments use ac/ic, class/type uses ak/ik to avoid Shift while keeping strings on at/it.
close_reason: Implemented Evil class/comment text object remapping and covered comment ranges with ERT tests.

title: Typing a closing brace should deindent when necessary
description: Typing a closing brace in pkl-ts-mode should immediately reindent/deindent the current line when the brace closes an object/class/list/parameter form. Consider using electric indentation integration, e.g. adding ?} to electric-indent-chars or a narrowly scoped post-self-insert behavior, so a newly inserted closing delimiter aligns with its parent without requiring manual TAB/indent-region.
acceptance_criteria: Typing } on an over-indented line deindents it to match the parent construct; existing indentation tests still pass; behavior is local to pkl-ts-mode and does not globally alter electric indentation.
close_reason: Added buffer-local electric-indent-chars (}, ], )) so typing a closing delimiter reindents the line to align with its parent. Tests and README updated; all 45 tests pass, compile clean.

title: Improve tree-sitter grammar installation guidance
description: The mode registers tree-sitter grammar source automatically, but the README only gives a minimal install instruction. Clarify how grammar installation interacts with auto-mode registration and how users can recover when the grammar is missing or installed after package load.
acceptance_criteria: README explains M-x treesit-install-language-grammar for pkl, what happens when the grammar is missing, and any relevant package reload/reopen steps after installation; guidance stays aligned with unconditional auto-mode behavior if that issue is completed.
close_reason: Added a dedicated 'Tree-sitter grammar' README section: how to install via M-x treesit-install-language-grammar (source pre-registered), the missing-grammar error and that file associations are unconditional, the M-x pkl-ts-mode/revert-buffer reload step after install, and how to load the package first to pre-install before opening a Pkl file.

title: Add structural navigation support
description: Consider adding outline and/or defun navigation support for Pkl. Typical Emacs language modes support commands such as beginning-of-defun/end-of-defun and outline/consult-outline for major declarations. Tree-sitter nodes for classes, methods, object bodies, and type aliases can provide stable anchors.
acceptance_criteria: Users can navigate between major Pkl declarations using standard Emacs navigation commands or outline integrations; behavior is documented; tests cover at least class, method, object, and typealias navigation if implemented.

title: Address code review nits on de0bc15
description: Code review follow-ups for the invalid URI handling commit: drop unused subr-x require, extract Pkl scopeUri into a defconst, flatten the eglot-server-programs registration, document the coupling to eglot--workspace-configuration-plist in tests, and factor out a server-construction helper. Per-item delegation in eglot-handle-request is intentional and stays as-is.

title: Consider paragraph text objects inside comments
description: Explore whether paragraph text objects should work meaningfully inside Pkl comments, so comment prose can still be edited by paragraph even if other programming-oriented text object keys are added.
design: Override evil ip/ap in pkl-ts-mode-map (operator+visual) rather than add a new key, to preserve gqip muscle memory. Behaviour is scoped: when point is inside a comment, return a paragraph range clamped to the comment run (reusing pkl-ts-mode--comment-range for bounds), with empty comment lines and blank lines acting as paragraph separators; otherwise delegate to stock evil-paragraph via evil-select-inner-object/evil-select-an-object. Consistent with existing it/at override for strings. Fixes ip grabbing adjacent code when no blank line separates a comment from following code.
notes: User request: lives on gqip for reflowing comment prose. Clamped-paragraph granularity (paragraph at point within the comment), not whole-comment (that is already ic).
close_reason: Implemented comment-aware ip/ap paragraph text objects: clamped to the comment run, split on empty comment/blank lines, fall back to stock evil-paragraph outside comments. Tests + README updated.
